A '''minecart''' is an iron item. [[Matcha Flavoured]] replaces its recipe with one that gives more when made from steel.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
5 iron ingots make 1 minecart, as in vanilla; 5 [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]] make 2. The vanilla recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/minecart_from_iron.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>
